newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattlemen await cold blast - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattlemen await cold blast - feedlots.

text.p: A winter-like storm forecast to hit the U.S. Plains early next week could lift asking prices for Nebraska feedlot cattle, feedlot sources said.

Cold and snow were forecast to reach Nebraska Tuesday, and feedlot sources said severe weather could stress cattle and delay marketings. Feedlots may raise asking prices from this week's trades of $108.00 to $109.00 per cwt on a dressed basis.
Next week's showlists will be about unchanged from this week's, they said.
"If the weather doesn't knock a bunch of cattle off the list, it will be about steady with this week," he said.
